title: Search: maximum term filter
description: Many customers do not want to commit for more than a certain time. Adds `max_term` (one of the configured terms) to the search, in filters() so it is cached separately, returning offers with a term of at most that many months. Tests added.

defects.explanation: Uses `<` instead of `<=`, so max_term=36 excludes 36-month offers although the filter means "at most 36 months" (the test only checks 24 and 48).
